subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
outcomes: I can read 'The Clothes Game' and talk about the girls' clothes.
I can read 'Dad's Tracksuit' and retell the story.
I can choose your, you're, they're and our.

tf.s: In 'The Clothes Game', the girls close their eyes and count to ten.
tf.why: Yes! They close their eyes and count to ten.

tf.s: The girls play the game in their bedroom.
tf.why: Right! The girls are in their bedroom.

tf.s: In the story, the girls' handbags are orange.
tf.why: Well done! Our handbags are orange.

tf.s: At the end of the game, the girls' clothes are the same.
tf.why: After the game, their clothes are different.

tf.s: At the end, the glasses are on her head.
In 'Dad's Tracksuit', Dad is sixteen in the picture.
tf.why: Right! Dad is sixteen in the old picture.

tf.s: Dad has got a beard in the picture.
tf.why: No, he hasn't got a beard in the picture.

tf.s: The football team's tracksuits are blue.
Dad gives the child his tracksuit and trainers.
tf.why: Yes! Now the child is wearing Dad's tracksuit.

tf.s: We say: You're tracksuit is cool, Dad.
tf.why: Before a noun we say Your: Your tracksuit is cool.

boxes.why: The girls play in their bedroom.

boxes.q: What do the girls count to?
boxes.why: They close their eyes and count to ten.

boxes.q: What colour are the girls' handbags?
Complete: Our slippers are fun and our ___ are cool.
How old is Dad in the picture?
boxes.why: Dad is sixteen in the picture.

boxes.q: Dad is in a … team in the picture.
What colour are the team's tracksuits?
Choose: ___ tracksuit and trainers are cool, Dad.
What kind of book does Dad have?
boxes.why: It's a special book with old pictures.

hunt.q: Our slippers are fun. Our ___ are cool.

mcq.q: In 'The Clothes Game', what do the girls say first?
mcq.why: The story starts with Let's play a game!

mcq.q: After the girls open their eyes, what do they ask?
o: Are our clothes the same or different?
mcq.why: They ask if their clothes are the same or different.

mcq.q: What does Dad show in 'Dad's Tracksuit'?
o: A special book with his football team
mcq.why: Dad shows a special book with a picture of his team.

mcq.q: What are the team wearing in the picture?
The girl asks: Where are my glasses? Choose the best answer.
mcq.why: They're = they are, so They're on your head.

mcq.q: Choose: ___ wearing slippers. (talking to your friend)
Which sentence is from 'The Clothes Game', not 'Dad's Tracksuit'?
o: Close your eyes and count to ten.
mcq.why: The girls count to ten in 'The Clothes Game'.

mcq.q: Put 'Dad's Tracksuit' in order: A. Dad gives the child his tracksuit. B. Dad shows a special book.
mcq.why: First Dad shows the book, then he gives the tracksuit.

mcq.q: Dad in the picture: sixteen, no beard. Why?
o: The picture is old, from when Dad was young.
It is a picture of the child.
The picture is from a shop.
mcq.why: It's an old picture of Dad when he was young.
